title.zh: 卷311 列傳九十八 哈攀龙 任举 冶大雄 马良柱 本进忠 刘顺
title.en: Volume 311 Biographies 98: Ha Pan Long, Ren Ju, Ye Da Xiong, Ma Liangzhu, Ben Jin Zhong, Liu Shun
title.raw: 卷311 列傳九十八 哈攀龙 任举 冶大雄 马良柱 本进忠 刘顺

sentences.zh: 列傳九十八

translations.literal: Biographies 98
translations.idiomatic: Biography 98

sentences.zh: 哈攀龍子國興任舉冶大雄馬良柱本進忠劉順

translations.literal: Ha Panlong, his son Guo Xing, Ren Ju, Ye Daxiong, Ma Liangzhu, Ben Jinzhong, Liu Shun
translations.idiomatic: Ha Panlong, Guo Xing, Ren Ju, Ye Daxiong, Ma Liangzhu, Ben Jinzhong, and Liu Shun

sentences.zh: 哈攀龍，直隸河間人，其先出回部。

translations.literal: Ha Panlong was a native of Hejian in Zhili; his ancestors came from the Hui communities.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Panlong was from Hejian in Zhili; his family traced its descent to the Hui communities.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年一甲一名武進士，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he took first place among the military jinshi of the top tier and was appointed a first-class imperial guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 (1737) he graduated at the head of the military jinshi of the top tier and was made a first-class imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 以副將發福建，除興化城守副將。

translations.literal: He was dispatched to Fujian as a brigade deputy commander and appointed deputy commander for the defense of Xinghua city.
translations.idiomatic: Posted to Fujian as a brigade deputy commander, he was then appointed deputy commander for the defense of Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 遷總兵，歷河南南陽，福建海壇、漳州諸鎮。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander and served in succession at Nanyang in Henan and at Haitan and Zhangzhou in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to regional commander, he served in turn at Nanyang in Henan and at Haitan and Zhangzhou in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 以母喪去官。

translations.literal: He left office on account of his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十三年，高宗東巡，攀龍迎鑾，命往金川，隸總督張廣泗軍，署松潘鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when Gaozong made an eastern tour, Panlong met the imperial carriage and was ordered to proceed to Jinchuan, serving under Governor Zhang Guangsi as acting regional commander of Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirteen, when the Qianlong Emperor toured the east, Panlong met the imperial progress and was sent to Jinchuan under Governor Zhang Guangsi, with acting command of Songpan.

sentences.zh: 出美諾溝，取撒臥山、大松林、噶達諸寨。

translations.literal: He marched out through Meinuo Ravine and took the stockades at Sawo Mountain, Great Pine Forest, and Gada.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing through Meinuo Ravine, he captured the stockades at Sawo Mountain, Great Pine Forest, and Gada.

sentences.zh: 分兵出馬溝右梁，察形勢，得其險要，搜截松林，賊蔽松設卡。

translations.literal: He detached troops to the right ridge of Magou, reconnoitered the terrain, seized its critical points, and searched through the pine forest; the rebels, sheltered by the pines, had set up stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Detaching troops to the right ridge of Magou, he reconnoitered the ground, seized the key points, and swept the pine forest, where the rebels had hidden among the trees and thrown up palisades.

sentences.zh: 毀其二，徑左梁山溝，砲斃賊數十。

translations.literal: He destroyed two of them, advanced by way of Zuoliangshan Ravine, and killed several tens of rebels with artillery.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed two of the palisades, pushed through Zuoliangshan Ravine, and killed several dozen rebels with cannon fire.

sentences.zh: 進克渴足寨，焚碉寨四、水城一，殺賊二十餘。

translations.literal: Advancing, he captured Kezu stockade, burned four blockhouse forts and one water fort, and killed more than twenty rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing forward he took Kezu stockade, burned four blockhouse forts and one water fort, and killed more than twenty rebels.

sentences.zh: 尋與署重慶鎮總兵任舉合兵攻色爾力石城，舉沒於陣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he joined Acting Chongqing Regional Commander Ren Ju to attack the stone fortress at Se'erli; Ju fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined Acting Chongqing commander Ren Ju in an assault on the stone fortress at Se'erli, where Ju was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 攀龍入林，殪賊三十餘，奪舉屍回。

translations.literal: Panlong entered the forest, killed more than thirty rebels, and recovered Ju's body.
translations.idiomatic: Panlong fought into the woods, killed more than thirty rebels, and brought Ju's body back.

sentences.zh: 复偕都統班第、署重慶鎮總兵段起賢、侍衛富成分道夜襲色爾力，焚木卡三，殺賊五十餘。

translations.literal: Again, together with Banner Commander Ban Di, Acting Chongqing Regional Commander Duan Qixian, and Guardsman Fucheng, he made a night attack on Se'erli by separate routes, burned three wooden palisades, and killed more than fifty rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Banner Commander Ban Di, Acting Chongqing commander Duan Qixian, and Guardsman Fucheng in a night assault on Se'erli from several directions, burning three wooden palisades and killing more than fifty rebels.

sentences.zh: 進破石梁、雙溝諸壘。

translations.literal: He advanced and broke the fortified positions at Shiliang and Shuanggou.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed on and stormed the fortified positions at Shiliang and Shuanggou.

sentences.zh: 經略訥親、總督張廣泗劾攀龍攻色爾力不能下，兵部議左遷。

translations.literal: Commissioner-General Neqin and Governor Zhang Guangsi impeached Panlong for failing to reduce Se'erli, and the Board of War recommended demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner-General Neqin and Governor Zhang Guangsi impeached Panlong for failing to take Se'erli, and the Board of War recommended his demotion.

sentences.zh: 上責攀龍自陳，攀龍言屢克卡殺賊報廣泗，廣泗不以入告。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Panlong to explain himself; Panlong said he had repeatedly reported the capture of stockades and the killing of rebels to Guangsi, but Guangsi had not passed these reports upward.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Panlong to account for himself; Panlong replied that he had repeatedly reported captures and kills to Guangsi, who had not relayed them to the court.

sentences.zh: 會訥親、廣泗皆得罪去，上知攀龍枉，命罷議。

translations.literal: When Neqin and Guangsi were both punished and removed, the emperor knew Panlong had been wronged and ordered the proceedings dropped.
translations.idiomatic: When Neqin and Guangsi were both punished and dismissed, the emperor saw that Panlong had been wronged and ordered the case closed.

sentences.zh: 尋從經略大學士傅恆夜攻色爾力，先登，拔石卡，殪賊數十。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed Commissioner-General and Grand Secretary Fu Heng in a night attack on Se'erli, was first to scale the walls, took the stone palisade, and killed several tens of rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Grand Secretary and commissioner-general Fu Heng in a night assault on Se'erli, was first over the wall, seized the stone palisade, and killed several dozen rebels.

sentences.zh: 十四年，金川事定，命署固原提督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, when the Jinchuan affair was settled, he was ordered to serve as acting provincial military commander of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In year fourteen, after Jinchuan was pacified, he was appointed acting provincial commander of Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，移湖廣提督，陳整飭弁兵諸事，上嘉勉之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to be provincial military commander of Huguang and memorialized on matters of disciplining officers and troops; the emperor praised and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: In year sixteen he was transferred to Huguang as provincial commander; his memorials on disciplining officers and troops won the emperor's praise.

sentences.zh: 尋命真除。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to receive formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon confirmed in the post.

sentences.zh: 复移貴州提督。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to be provincial military commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then transferred to Guizhou as provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 入陛見，病留京師，卒。

translations.literal: He entered the capital for an audience, fell ill and remained in the capital, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Called to court for an audience, he fell ill in the capital and died there.

sentences.zh: 子國興，乾隆十七年武進士，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Guo Xing, a military jinshi in the seventeenth year of Qianlong, was appointed a third-class imperial guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guo Xing took the military jinshi in Qianlong 17 (1752) and was made a third-class imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 出為雲南督標右營游擊，遷東川營參將。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as a battalion colonel in the right camp of the Yunnan provincial command and was promoted to regimental colonel of the Dongchuan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Posted as battalion colonel in the right camp of the Yunnan provincial command, he was promoted to regimental colonel of the Dongchuan garrison.

sentences.zh: 緬甸頭人召散據孟艮為亂。

translations.literal: The Burmese chieftain Zhaosan seized Menggen and rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese chieftain Zhaosan seized Menggen and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 總督楊應琚檄國興佐軍，戰楞木，進克猛卯，督戰被槍，創右輔及臂。

translations.literal: Governor Yang Yingju ordered Guo Xing to assist the army; he fought at Lengmu, advanced and captured Mengmao, and while directing the battle was shot, wounded in the right cheek and arm.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yang Yingju called Guo Xing to the field; he fought at Lengmu, took Mengmao, and while directing the battle was shot in the right cheek and arm.

sentences.zh: 應琚以聞，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: Yingju reported this, and he was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju reported the wound, and the court awarded him a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 尋署騰越營副將。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed acting brigade deputy commander of the Tengyue garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made acting brigade deputy commander at Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 時副將趙宏榜以偏師深入，與緬人戰於新街，師敗績。

translations.literal: At that time Brigade Deputy Commander Zhao Hongbang led a detached column deep into enemy country and fought the Burmese at Xinjie; the army suffered a defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade deputy Zhao Hongbang had led a detached column deep into Burma and been defeated at Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 國興師至蠻暮，诇新街無備，督兵潛入，緬人乃引退。

translations.literal: Guo Xing's troops reached Manmu; learning that Xinjie was undefended, he led his men in secretly, and the Burmese then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing reached Manmu, found Xinjie unguarded, slipped troops in by stealth, and the Burmese withdrew.

sentences.zh: 從將軍明瑞進克木邦，戰於蠻暮，大破之。

translations.literal: Following General Ming Rui he advanced and captured Mubang; fighting at Manmu, he inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Following General Ming Rui he took Mubang and won a major victory at Manmu.

sentences.zh: 复偕侍衛莽克察擊斬守隘賊六十餘。

translations.literal: Again, together with Guardsman Mangkecha, he attacked and killed more than sixty rebels guarding the passes.
translations.idiomatic: With Guardsman Mangkecha he attacked the pass defenders and killed more than sixty.

sentences.zh: 擢楚姚鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander of Chuyao.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander of Chuyao.

sentences.zh: 入陛見，命在乾清門行走，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: He entered the capital for an audience, was ordered to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, and was bestowed silver and coins.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to court, he was assigned to duty at the Gate of Heavenly Purity and rewarded with silver and coins.

sentences.zh: 還軍，移普洱鎮總兵，遷貴州提督。

translations.literal: Returning to the army, he was transferred to regional commander of Pu'er and then promoted to provincial military commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the field, he was moved to Pu'er as regional commander and then to Guizhou as provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 經略傅恆議用水師，令國興赴銅壁關外野人山督造船。

translations.literal: Commissioner-General Fu Heng proposed using a naval force and ordered Guo Xing to go beyond Tongbi Pass to the Wild Man Mountains to supervise shipbuilding.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner-general Fu Heng planned a river fleet and sent Guo Xing beyond Tongbi Pass to the Wild Man Mountains to oversee construction.

sentences.zh: 移雲南提督，加太子少保。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be provincial military commander of Yunnan and given the additional title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Yunnan as provincial commander, he was also made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 船成，從傅恆出猛拱、孟養、南豐、猛烈、猛壩，次老官屯。

translations.literal: When the ships were ready he followed Fu Heng out through Menggong, Mengyang, Nanfeng, Menglie, and Mengba, halting at Laoguantun.
translations.idiomatic: When the fleet was ready he followed Fu Heng through Menggong, Mengyang, Nanfeng, Menglie, and Mengba to Laoguantun.

sentences.zh: 緬人水陸備甚固，攻之不時下。

translations.literal: The Burmese defenses on land and water were very strong, and the attack could not be brought to a timely conclusion.
translations.idiomatic: Burmese land and river defenses were formidable, and the assault could not be pressed to a quick finish.

sentences.zh: 頭人諾爾塔以其酋懵駁命，遣使得魯蘊詣軍乞解兵。

translations.literal: The chieftain Nuo'erta, because their ruler Mengbo had been killed, sent an envoy named Deluyun to the army to beg that troops be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain Nuo'erta, with their ruler Mengbo dead, sent the envoy Deluyun to ask for a withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 傅恆令國興出見，曉以利害，令具約十年一貢，毋更擾邊，歸所掠內地人。

translations.literal: Fu Heng ordered Guo Xing to go out and meet him, explained the advantages and disadvantages, and required a written agreement for tribute once every ten years, no further border raids, and the return of people seized from the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng had Guo Xing meet the envoy, explain the stakes, and draw up terms: tribute every ten years, no further border raids, and the return of captives taken inland.

sentences.zh: 緬人誓奉約。

translations.literal: The Burmese swore to abide by the agreement.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese swore to keep the agreement.

sentences.zh: 時傅恆方病，將軍阿桂召從征諸大臣議，皆言許之便，遂與定約解兵。

translations.literal: At that time Fu Heng was ill; General Agui summoned the ministers on the campaign to deliberate, and all said it would be expedient to grant the request; they therefore concluded the agreement and withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng was ill; General Agui called the ministers on campaign to council, all favored acceptance, and the army made peace and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 既而貢弗至，總督彰寶遣都司蘇爾相諭意，留不遣，揚言國興許以木邦、猛拱、蠻暮三土司予緬人，請如議。

translations.literal: Afterward tribute did not arrive; Governor Zhang Bao sent Colonel Su Erxiang to convey his wishes, detained him and would not send him back, and spread word that Guo Xing had promised the three native offices of Mubang, Menggong, and Manmu to the Burmese, asking that this be carried out as agreed.
translations.idiomatic: When tribute failed to arrive, Governor Zhang Bao sent Colonel Su Erxiang on embassy but detained him, claiming Guo Xing had promised Mubang, Menggong, and Manmu to Burma and demanding the transfer.

sentences.zh: 彰寶劾國興與緬人議具約不以實，上召國興至京師，詰國興，國興自陳未嘗有此議。

translations.literal: Zhang Bao impeached Guo Xing for not reporting truthfully on his negotiations with the Burmese; the emperor summoned Guo Xing to the capital and questioned him; Guo Xing declared he had never made such an agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bao impeached Guo Xing for misreporting the Burmese negotiations; summoned to the capital, Guo Xing denied ever promising the three domains.

sentences.zh: 上責國興遷就畢事，奪太子少保，左授貴州古州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached Guo Xing for compromising to finish the affair, stripped him of the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and demoted him to regional commander of Guzhou in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Guo Xing for settling too cheaply, stripped his Junior Guardian title, and demoted him to regional commander at Guzhou in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 移雲南臨元鎮。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Linyuan command in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Linyuan command in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 後二年，得魯蘊復至老官屯，請如前誓三事。

translations.literal: Two years later Deluyun came again to Laoguantun and requested the three matters sworn to before.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Deluyun returned to Laoguantun and asked that the three earlier pledges be honored.

sentences.zh: 時師徵金川，上命國興從將軍溫福進討。

translations.literal: At that time the army was campaigning against Jinchuan, and the emperor ordered Guo Xing to follow General Wenfu in the advance.
translations.idiomatic: While the army was campaigning in Jinchuan, the emperor ordered Guo Xing to join General Wenfu.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，遷西安提督，命盡護陝西、甘肅從征諸軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he was transferred to be provincial military commander of Xi'an and ordered to take full charge of all troops from Shaanxi and Gansu on the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-seven he was made provincial commander of Xi'an with overall charge of the Shaanxi and Gansu contingents.

sentences.zh: 尋令偕總兵董天弼自曾頭溝取底木達、布朗郭宗。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered, together with Regional Commander Dong Tianbi, to take Dimuda and Bulangguozong from Zengtou Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered with Regional Commander Dong Tianbi to take Dimuda and Bulangguozong from Zengtou Ravine.

sentences.zh: 溫福以國興能軍，令自策卜丹徑取美諾當一面。

translations.literal: Wenfu, because Guo Xing was skilled in military affairs, ordered him to strike directly at Meinuo from Cebudan and hold that front alone.
translations.idiomatic: Judging Guo Xing an able commander, Wenfu sent him straight from Cebudan against Meinuo on his own front.

sentences.zh: 國興自阿喀木雅山溝紆道徑瑪爾迪克山寨，察策卜丹地勢，林深徑狹，不宜於行師，乃將二千人佐海蘭察攻瑪爾迪克。

translations.literal: Guo Xing, by a circuitous route through the Akemuya mountain ravine, went straight to the stockade at Ma'erdike; observing the terrain at Cebudan, he found the forest deep and the paths narrow, unsuitable for moving troops, and therefore led two thousand men to assist Hailancha in attacking Ma'erdike.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing took a detour through Akemuya Ravine toward Ma'erdike stockade; finding Cebudan's forests too deep and paths too narrow for a main column, he left two thousand men with Hailancha to assault Ma'erdike.

sentences.zh: 溫福再疏聞上。

translations.literal: Wenfu memorialized the emperor again.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu reported again to the throne.

sentences.zh: 金川賊千餘屯貢噶山左，謀劫糧，國興馳擊，賊敗匿。

translations.literal: More than a thousand Jinchuan rebels were encamped to the left of Gongga Mountain, plotting to seize grain supplies; Guo Xing galloped to attack, and the rebels were defeated and went into hiding.
translations.idiomatic: More than a thousand rebels lay to the left of Gongga Mountain, plotting to cut the grain route; Guo Xing rode them down and they scattered into hiding.

sentences.zh: 師還，經瑪爾迪克，賊自林中出，复擊敗之，上賚荷包四。

translations.literal: As the army returned and passed Ma'erdike, rebels came out from the forest; he again defeated them, and the emperor bestowed four purses.
translations.idiomatic: On the march back through Ma'erdike rebels burst from the woods; he beat them off again and received four imperial purses.

sentences.zh: 進攻貢噶山，設伏，斬賊百餘，搜箐奪碉卡。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Gongga Mountain, set an ambush, beheaded more than a hundred rebels, searched the ravines, and seized blockhouse stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Gongga Mountain he laid an ambush, killed more than a hundred rebels, swept the ravines, and took the blockhouse palisades.

sentences.zh: 九月，金川酋索諾木使詣國興，請獻鄂克什地以降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu sent envoys to Guo Xing, offering to surrender the territory of Ekeshe.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jinchuan chief Suonuomu sent envoys offering to yield Ekeshe in submission.

sentences.zh: 國興令並割南北兩山美美卡、木蘭壩及瑪爾迪克。

translations.literal: Guo Xing ordered that he also cede Meimeika on the northern and southern mountains, Mulanba, and Ma'erdike.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing demanded Meimeika on both northern and southern ridges, Mulanba, and Ma'erdike as well.

sentences.zh: 越日，賊盡撤諸柵。

translations.literal: The next day the rebels withdrew from all their palisades.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels abandoned every palisade.

sentences.zh: 國興以兵入鄂克什舊寨，賊退守路頂宗。

translations.literal: Guo Xing led troops into the old stockade at Ekeshe; the rebels fell back to defend Ludingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing occupied the old Ekeshe stockade while the rebels fell back to Ludingzong.

sentences.zh: 十月，使歸墨壟溝師敗時所掠外委臧儒，且言嘗勸僧格桑同降。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the envoys returned Sub-lieutenant Zang Ru, seized when the army was defeated at Molong Ravine, and said they had once urged Senge Sang to surrender together.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they returned Sub-lieutenant Zang Ru, captured when the army was beaten at Molong Ravine, and said they had urged Senge Sang to submit with them.

sentences.zh: 溫福以聞，上令國興檄諭索諾木聲其罪。

translations.literal: Wenfu reported this; the emperor ordered Guo Xing to issue a proclamation denouncing Suonuomu's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu reported the exchange; the emperor had Guo Xing proclaim Suonuomu's crimes.

sentences.zh: 時國興及海蘭察將五千人屯貢噶山，謀攻策卜丹，阻冰雪未進。

translations.literal: At that time Guo Xing and Hailancha had five thousand men encamped at Gongga Mountain, planning to attack Cebudan, but were blocked by ice and snow and could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing and Hailancha had five thousand men at Gongga Mountain planning an assault on Cebudan, but ice and snow held them back.

sentences.zh: 上命還師攻路頂宗。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the army to turn back and attack Ludingzong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered them to turn back and take Ludingzong.

sentences.zh: 路頂宗山麓有巨溝，溝源出南山。

translations.literal: At the foot of Ludingzong Mountain there was a great ravine whose source lay in the southern mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At the foot of Ludingzong stood a great ravine fed from the southern ridge.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察紆道出山後，侍衛額森特自小徑為應，國興前越溝攻碉。

translations.literal: Hailancha took a circuitous route to come out behind the mountain; Guardsman Esente moved along a small path in support; Guo Xing advanced in front, crossed the ravine, and attacked the blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Hailancha circled behind the mountain, Guardsman Esente struck along a side path, and Guo Xing crossed the ravine in front to storm the blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 師繼進，遂克路頂宗，破卡五十餘、碉三百餘，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: The army pressed on and took Ludingzong, destroying more than fifty stockades and more than three hundred blockhouses, with very many captives.
translations.idiomatic: The main force followed up, took Ludingzong, destroyed more than fifty palisades and three hundred blockhouses, and took many prisoners.

sentences.zh: 復自喀木色爾北山攻穆拉斯郭大寨，進據兜烏山巔，與總兵馬彪軍合，奪附近碉卡，克額爾奔木柵。

translations.literal: Again, from the northern mountain at Kamuse'er he attacked the great stockade at Mulasi Guo, advanced to hold the summit of Douwu Mountain, joined Regional Commander Ma Biao's army, seized nearby blockhouse stockades, and captured the palisade at E'erbenmu.
translations.idiomatic: From Kamuse'er's northern ridge he stormed the great stockade at Mulasi Guo, seized the summit of Douwu Mountain, joined Ma Biao's column, cleared the nearby blockhouses, and took E'erbenmu palisade.

sentences.zh: 復將千人渡水，自南山鄂爾濟仰攻，克諸寨，與大軍會，進攻明郭宗。

translations.literal: Again he led a thousand men across the water, attacked upward from the southern mountain at E'erji, captured the stockades, joined the main army, and advanced to attack Mingguozong.
translations.idiomatic: With a thousand men he crossed the river, climbed from E'erji on the southern ridge, took the stockades, rejoined the main army, and advanced on Mingguozong.

sentences.zh: 別以兵襲擊公雅山，克木爾古魯寨，並奪據嘉巴山麓。

translations.literal: With separate troops he made a surprise attack on Gongya Mountain, captured the stockade at Mu'ergulu, and also seized the foothills of Jiaba Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: A detached column struck Gongya Mountain, took Mu'ergulu stockade, and seized the foothills of Jiaba.

sentences.zh: 廷議既定小金川，分命將帥三道進討金川。

translations.literal: The court decided that Lesser Jinchuan was settled and ordered commanders to advance against Jinchuan on three routes.
translations.idiomatic: With Lesser Jinchuan settled, the court ordered a three-pronged advance on Greater Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「國興雖綠營漢員，熟軍事；

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Although Guo Xing is a Han officer of the Green Standard Army, he is skilled in military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Though Guo Xing is a Han Green Standard officer, he knows war;

sentences.zh: 又嘗為乾清門侍衛，與滿洲大臣無異。

translations.literal: and he has also served as a guardsman at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, no different from a Manchu grand minister."
translations.idiomatic: and having served at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, he stands on no different footing from a Manchu minister."

sentences.zh: 」授參贊大臣，佐副將軍豐升額。

translations.literal: He was appointed a participating commissioner and assisted Deputy Commander-in-Chief Feng Sheng'e.
translations.idiomatic: He was made a participating commissioner to assist Deputy Commander-in-Chief Feng Sheng'e.

sentences.zh: 是月克明郭宗，焚念經樓。

translations.literal: That month they captured Mingguozong and burned the sutra-recitation hall.
translations.idiomatic: That month they took Mingguozong and burned the scripture hall.

sentences.zh: 整兵進取日果爾烏谷山麓，攻美諾。

translations.literal: He reorganized the army, advanced to the foothills of Riguo'erwu Valley, and attacked Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: He reformed his troops, pushed to the foothills of Riguo'erwu Valley, and assaulted Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 上嘉國興功，官其子文虎守備。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Guo Xing's merit and appointed his son Wenhu as a garrison commandant.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded Guo Xing by appointing his son Wenhu a garrison commandant.

sentences.zh: 攻克布朗郭宗，僧格桑遁金川。

translations.literal: They captured Bulangguozong; Senge Sang fled to Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: They took Bulangguozong while Senge Sang fled into Greater Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 我軍直抵底木達，僧格桑父澤旺出降。

translations.literal: Our army pressed straight to Dimuda; Senge Sang's father Zewang came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The army pushed to Dimuda, where Senge Sang's father Zewang submitted.

sentences.zh: 小金川平。

translations.literal: Lesser Jinchuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Jinchuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 國興卒於軍，賜白金千，存卹其家，加贈太子太保，諡壯武。

translations.literal: Guo Xing died in the army; he was granted a thousand taels of white silver, his family was given relief, he was posthumously promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and given the posthumous title Zhuangwu.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing died in camp; the court granted a thousand taels of silver, relieved his family, posthumously made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and gave him the posthumous name Zhuangwu (Stalwart in War).

sentences.zh: 祀昭忠祠，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: He was enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty and his portrait hung in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 文虎授陝西提標右營守備，從軍攻木果木，陣沒，從祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: Wenhu was appointed garrison commandant of the right camp of the Shaanxi provincial command; he followed the army to attack Mugumu, fell in battle, and was granted secondary enshrinement in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Wenhu was made garrison commandant of the Shaanxi provincial right camp, joined the assault on Mugumu, fell in battle, and was enshrined alongside his father.

sentences.zh: 复官次子文彪千總。

translations.literal: His second son Wenbiao was again given office as a company captain.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Wenbiao was appointed a company captain.

sentences.zh: 任舉，山西大同人。

translations.literal: Ren Ju was a native of Datong in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Ju was from Datong in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年武進士。

translations.literal: He was a military jinshi in the second year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: He took the military jinshi in Yongzheng 2 (1724).

sentences.zh: 以守備發陝西。

translations.literal: He was dispatched to Shaanxi as a garrison commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to Shaanxi as a garrison commandant.

sentences.zh: 累遷固原提標左營游擊，署城守營參將。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to battalion colonel of the left camp of the Guyuan provincial command and acting regimental colonel of the city-defense garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to battalion colonel of the Guyuan provincial left camp and acting regimental colonel of the city garrison.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年十二月，固原兵變，夜攻提督許仕盛，毀轅門將入。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year of Qianlong the Guyuan troops mutinied; by night they attacked Provincial Commander Xu Shisheng, destroyed the main gate, and were about to enter.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Qianlong 11 (1746) the Guyuan garrison mutinied, attacked Provincial Commander Xu Shisheng by night, smashed the main gate, and nearly broke in.

sentences.zh: 舉聞亂，單騎詣鼓樓鳴角，招營兵未變者才五十人，部勒使成列。

translations.literal: Ju heard of the disturbance, rode alone to the drum tower and sounded the horn, and gathered only fifty soldiers in the camp who had not mutinied; he drilled them into formation.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the uproar, Ju rode alone to the drum tower, sounded the horn, and mustered only fifty men who had not joined the mutiny, forming them into ranks.

sentences.zh: 變兵懼，退掠市廛。

translations.literal: The mutineers were afraid and withdrew to plunder the markets.
translations.idiomatic: The mutineers fell back in fear and looted the town.

sentences.zh: 舉追及，手刃十餘人，擒四十餘人。

translations.literal: Ju overtook them, killed more than ten with his own hand, and captured more than forty.
translations.idiomatic: Ju overtook them, killed more than ten with his own blade, and captured more than forty.

sentences.zh: 變兵出城南門，還攻東西二門。

translations.literal: The mutineers went out the south gate and returned to attack the eastern and western gates.
translations.idiomatic: The mutineers slipped out the south gate and turned back on the east and west gates.

sentences.zh: 舉守東門，右營游擊鐵保守西門，禦戰，變兵潰。

translations.literal: Ju defended the east gate; Battalion Colonel Tie Bao of the right camp defended the west gate; they fought off the attack and the mutineers were routed.
translations.idiomatic: Ju held the east gate while Battalion Colonel Tie Bao of the right camp held the west; together they broke the assault and routed the mutineers.

sentences.zh: 事定，總督慶復以聞，擢中軍參將。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Governor Qing Fu reported it, and Ju was promoted to regimental colonel of the central army.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored, Governor Qing Fu reported the affair and Ju was promoted to central-army regimental colonel.

sentences.zh: 十二年，命徵金川，隸總督張廣泗軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was ordered to campaign against Jinchuan and served under Governor Zhang Guangsi.
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve he was ordered to Jinchuan under Governor Zhang Guangsi.

sentences.zh: 尋授西鳳協副將。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed brigade deputy commander of the Xifeng garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made brigade deputy commander of the Xifeng garrison.

sentences.zh: 舉至軍，與總兵許應虎、副將高宗瑾、參將買國良攻色底賊碉，擊以砲二百餘發，碉一角圮，垣鑿孔發砲，密如鱗比。

translations.literal: Ju arrived at the army and, together with Regional Commander Xu Yinghu, Brigade Deputy Gao Zongjin, and Regimental Colonel Mai Guoliang, attacked the rebel blockhouses at Sedi; they fired more than two hundred rounds of artillery, one corner of a blockhouse collapsed, and holes were cut in the wall to fire cannon through, dense as scales laid in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Ju joined the army and, with Regional Commander Xu Yinghu, Brigade Deputy Gao Zongjin, and Regimental Colonel Mai Guoliang, assaulted the rebel blockhouses at Sedi; after more than two hundred cannon shots brought down a corner of one fort, they bored holes in the walls to keep firing until the openings stood scale-tight along the ramparts.

sentences.zh: 舉度我軍砲小不能下，將移軍退守，賊出戰，再設伏敗之。

translations.literal: Ju judged that their cannon were too small to bring the fort down and was about to withdraw the army to defensive positions; the rebels came out to fight, and he set an ambush and defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: Judging their guns too light to reduce the fort, Ju prepared to pull back to the defensive line; when the rebels sallied out, he laid another ambush and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十三年，上諭謂：「在軍諸將狃於瞻對之役，庸懦欺矇，已成夙習。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the emperor issued an edict saying: "The generals in the army, habituated to the Zhandui campaign, have grown slothful and cowardly in deceit — this has become a longstanding practice.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirteen the emperor declared: "The commanders in the field, spoiled by the Zhandui campaign, have made timidity and double-dealing a fixed habit."

sentences.zh: 今別用舉等，皆未從征瞻對，無所掣肘，宜鼓勵勇往。

translations.literal: Now, employing Ju and the others separately — none of them served in the Zhandui campaign and have no restraints — they should be encouraged to press forward boldly.
translations.idiomatic: "Ju and the others are being used afresh; none served at Zhandui and none are held back by old habits — they should be urged to advance boldly."

sentences.zh: 」廣泗亦奏在川鎮將，忠誠勇幹無出舉右者，令率漢、土兵三千取道攻昔嶺。

translations.literal: Guangsi also memorialized that among the commanders in Sichuan, none surpassed Ju in loyalty, courage, and ability, and ordered him to lead three thousand Han and native troops by a separate route to attack Xiling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi also reported that among Sichuan's regional commanders none matched Ju in loyalty, courage, or capacity, and ordered him to lead three thousand Han and native troops against Xiling by a separate route.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏令署重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized again to appoint Ju acting regional commander of Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: He soon memorialized again to make Ju acting regional commander of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 舉與參將王愷自牛廠至素可尼山。

translations.literal: Ju and Regimental Colonel Wang Kai marched from Niuchang to Sokeni Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Ju and Regimental Colonel Wang Kai advanced from Niuchang to Sokeni Mountain.

sentences.zh: 時五月，遇大雪，闢道以行。

translations.literal: It was the fifth month; they encountered heavy snow and cut a road to advance.
translations.idiomatic: It was the fifth month; they met heavy snow and had to cut a path forward.

sentences.zh: 經撒烏山，至昔嶺山梁，山北曰木岡，孤峰當道，賊置城卡守隘。

translations.literal: Passing Sawu Mountain, they reached the ridge of Xiling; to the north of the mountain was Mugang — a lone peak blocking the road, where the rebels had set up walled palisades to guard the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Sawu Mountain they reached the Xiling ridge; north of the peak lay Mugang, a solitary height blocking the road, where the rebels had thrown up walled palisades to hold the pass.

sentences.zh: 舉督兵攻卡，憑高發砲洞其垣，令土兵緣溝潛進，毀賊碉。

translations.literal: Ju directed the troops to attack the palisades, fired cannon from high ground to breach the walls, ordered native troops to advance secretly along the ditches, and destroyed the rebel blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Ju directed the assault on the palisades, shelled the walls from the heights until they were breached, sent native troops creeping along the ditches, and destroyed the rebel blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 師循出山腰，克賊卡，遂陟中峰，以千人駐守，進攻木岡。

translations.literal: The army wound out along the mountainside, captured the rebel palisades, then ascended the central peak, garrisoned a thousand men there, and advanced to attack Mugang.
translations.idiomatic: The column worked out along the mountainside, took the rebel palisades, climbed the central peak, left a thousand men to hold it, and pressed on against Mugang.

sentences.zh: 時總兵哈攀龍師至馬溝右梁，阻松林不得進。

translations.literal: At that time Regional Commander Ha Panlong's forces reached the right ridge of Magou but were blocked by the pine forest and could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ha Panlong's column had reached the right ridge of Magou but was stopped by the pine woods and could not get through.

sentences.zh: 廣泗令自納喇溝出昔嶺右，與舉合攻木岡賊所署城卡，力戰未即下。

translations.literal: Guangsi ordered him to come out through Nala Ravine to the right of Xiling and join Ju in attacking the walled palisades the rebels had established at Mugang; they fought fiercely but did not capture them immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi ordered Panlong out through Nala Ravine on Xiling's right to join Ju in storming the walled palisades at Mugang; despite fierce fighting the position did not fall at once.

sentences.zh: 舉察昔嶺左有道通卡撒，中經得思東、木達溝，賊皆置碉焉。

translations.literal: Ju discovered that to the left of Xiling a road led to Kasai, passing through Desidong and Mida Ravine, where the rebels had all placed blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Ju found a route on Xiling's left to Kasai through Desidong and Mida Ravine, where the rebels had blockhouses all along the way.

sentences.zh: 總兵冶​​大雄方自卡撒進，舉與合軍，焚木達溝諸碉，圍得思東，斷其汲道，督兵挾斧斫賊，賊墮岩遁，得大小碉三。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Ye Daxiong was just advancing from Kasai; Ju joined forces with him, burned the blockhouses in Mida Ravine, surrounded Desidong, cut off their water supply, directed troops wielding axes to hack at the rebels, the rebels fell from the cliffs and fled, and they captured three blockhouses large and small.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ye Daxiong was advancing from Kasai; Ju united with him, burned the blockhouses in Mida Ravine, invested Desidong and cut its water route, and drove his men in with axes until the rebels plunged from the cliffs and fled, yielding three blockhouses large and small.

sentences.zh: 進攻色爾力石城，分兵為三道：舉督兵直攻石城，攀龍出其右，副將唐開中及國良出其左。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack the stone fortress at Se'erli, they divided the army into three routes: Ju directed troops in a frontal assault on the stone fortress, Panlong came out on the right, and Brigade Deputy Tang Kaizhong and Guoliang on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on the stone fortress at Se'erli, they split into three columns: Ju struck the fortress head-on, Panlong took the right, and Brigade Deputy Tang Kaizhong and Guoliang the left.

sentences.zh: 越溝度林，攻賊所置木城，國良戰死。

translations.literal: Crossing ravines and passing through forests, they attacked the wooden fortress the rebels had built; Guoliang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing ravines and threading the woods, they assaulted the rebels' wooden fort; Guoliang was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，舉與攀龍、開中合攻石城，城堅甚。

translations.literal: On the sixth month's day jisi, Ju joined Panlong and Kaizhong in a combined assault on the stone fortress; the fortress was very strong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the sixth month Ju, Panlong, and Kaizhong joined in a combined assault on the stone fortress, which proved extremely strong.

sentences.zh: 我師方力攻，賊三百餘自西南林內出，舉督兵與戰，被創；

translations.literal: As our army was pressing the attack, more than three hundred rebels emerged from the forest to the southwest; Ju directed the troops to fight them and was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: While the army was pressing hard, more than three hundred rebels burst from the southwest woods; Ju led the counterattack and was wounded.

sentences.zh: 戰益力，槍復中要害，遂卒。

translations.literal: He fought with even greater force, was struck again by a musket in a vital spot, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He fought on with redoubled fury until a musket ball struck a vital spot and he fell dead.

sentences.zh: 攀龍入林殺賊，以其屍還。

translations.literal: Panlong entered the forest and killed rebels, then returned with his body.
translations.idiomatic: Panlong fought into the woods, killed rebels, and brought Ju's body back.

sentences.zh: 時上方命舉真除，經略大學士訥親以舉死事聞，上閱疏為泣下，並諭：「舉忠憤激發，甘死如飴，而朕以小丑跳梁，用良臣於危地，思之深惻！

translations.literal: At that time the emperor had just ordered Ju's formal appointment; Commissioner-General and Grand Secretary Neqin reported Ju's death in service; the emperor, reading the memorial, wept and also issued an edict: "Ju, stirred by loyal indignation, welcomed death as though it were sweet; yet I, on account of petty rebels rampaging, sent a worthy minister into peril — the thought cuts deeply!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had just ordered Ju's formal appointment when Commissioner-General Neqin reported his death in battle; reading the memorial, the emperor wept and declared: "Ju, roused by loyal wrath, met death as gladly as sweetness — yet I, over trifling rebels in revolt, put a good man in mortal danger; the thought wounds me deeply!"

sentences.zh: 」命視提督例賜卹，加都督同知，諡勇烈，祀昭忠祠，官其子承恩都司，承緒千總。

translations.literal: He was ordered granted posthumous compensation on the model of a provincial commander, conferred Vice Commissioner-in-chief of the Chief Commandant's Office, given the posthumous title Yonglie, enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, and his sons Chengen and Chenxu were given office as battalion commander and company captain respectively.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted posthumous relief on the scale accorded a provincial commander, raised posthumously to Vice Commissioner-in-chief, given the posthumous name Yonglie (Valiant and Steadfast), enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, and his sons Chengen and Chenxu were appointed battalion commander and company captain.

sentences.zh: 承恩喪終入謝，上以尚幼，命傳諭其母善教之。

translations.literal: When Chengen completed mourning and came to give thanks, the emperor, seeing he was still young, ordered a message conveyed to his mother to train him well.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengen came to court after mourning, the emperor, finding him still young, sent word to his mother to raise him with care.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, he was appointed a third-class imperial guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-four he was made a third-class imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 累遷福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to provincial military commander of Fujian's land forces.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in time to provincial commander of Fujian's land forces.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，台灣林爽文為亂，承恩請往討之，師無功，逮詣京師，罪當死，上寬之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, Lin Shuangwen rebelled in Taiwan; Chengen requested to go suppress him; the army achieved nothing, he was arrested and brought to the capital, his offense merited death, but the emperor showed leniency.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-two, when Lin Shuangwen rebelled in Taiwan, Chengen volunteered to suppress him; the campaign failed, he was brought to the capital under arrest, and though his crime warranted death the emperor spared him.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，赦出獄。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year, he was pardoned and released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-three he was pardoned and released from prison.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，复授巡捕營參將，遷副將。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, he was again appointed regimental colonel of the patrol garrison and promoted to brigade deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-five he was again made regimental colonel of the patrol garrison and promoted to brigade deputy.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 承緒官巡捕營游擊，市中火，赴救被創，卒。

translations.literal: Chenxu served as battalion colonel of the patrol garrison; during a fire in the city he went to the rescue, was wounded, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Chenxu held the post of battalion colonel in the patrol garrison; when fire broke out in the city he rushed to help, was wounded, and died.

sentences.zh: 上之赦承恩，謂其未有子，承緒又死勤事，不可使舉無嗣也。

translations.literal: In pardoning Chengen, the emperor said he had no son yet and Chenxu had died in public service — Ju must not be left without an heir.
translations.idiomatic: In pardoning Chengen the emperor noted that he had no son of his own and Chenxu had died in duty — Ren Ju's line could not be allowed to end.

sentences.zh: 冶大雄，四川成都人。

translations.literal: Ye Daxiong was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Daxiong was from Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 康熙季年入伍，從征西藏，克里塘、巴塘，降結敦落籠宗、說板多打籠宗諸寨，獲為亂喇嘛五。

translations.literal: In the final years of Kangxi he enrolled in the army, campaigned in Tibet at Kham and Batang, received the surrender of stockades including Jiedunluozong and Shuobanduodazong, and captured five rebellious lamas.
translations.idiomatic: Enlisting in the army in Kangxi's last years, he campaigned in Tibet through Kham and Batang, received the submission of stockades including Jiedunluozong and Shuobanduodazong, and took five rebel lamas.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，從軍出松潘黃勝關，剿撫熱當十二部落。

translations.literal: In the early Yongzheng period he campaigned out through Huang Sheng Pass at Songpan, suppressing and pacifying twelve Hotang tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In early Yongzheng he marched out through Huang Sheng Pass at Songpan to suppress and pacify twelve Hotang tribes.

sentences.zh: 攻郭隆寺，攻嶺三，破寨十五，追斬康布喇嘛於西海。

translations.literal: He attacked Gelong Monastery, stormed three ridges, broke fifteen stockades, and pursued and killed the Kangbo lama at Xihai.
translations.idiomatic: He assaulted Gelong Monastery, took three ridges and fifteen stockades, and pursued and killed the Kangbo lama at Xihai.

sentences.zh: 又從征桌子山、棋子山，戮頭人。

translations.literal: He again campaigned at Zhuozi Mountain and Qizi Mountain and killed chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned again at Zhuozi Mountain and Qizi Mountain and killed local chieftains.

sentences.zh: 追剿羅卜藏丹津，擒丹津琿台吉。

translations.literal: Pursuing Lobzang Danjin, he captured the Hūtaiji Danjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the pursuit of Lobzang Danjin he captured the taiji Danjin.

sentences.zh: 川陝總督岳鍾琪疏薦，引見，特授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Yue Zhongqi memorialized recommending him; he was granted an audience and specially appointed an imperial guardsman with the blue arrow feather.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yue Zhongqi of Sichuan-Shaanxi recommended him; summoned to audience, he was specially made an imperial guardsman with the blue arrow feather.

sentences.zh: 累遷陝西莊浪營參將。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to regimental colonel of the Zhuanglang garrison in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to regimental colonel of the Zhuanglang garrison in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 加副將銜，賜孔雀翎，命赴巴里坤軍，檄署川陝標中軍副將。

translations.literal: Given the additional rank of brigade deputy, granted a peacock feather, ordered to proceed to the Barkol army, and by dispatch appointed acting brigade deputy of the central army of the Sichuan-Shaanxi provincial command.
translations.idiomatic: Raised to brigade deputy by title, given a peacock feather, and sent to the Barkol army, he was by dispatch made acting brigade deputy of the Sichuan-Shaanxi provincial central command.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾犯克什圖、峨崙磯諸卡倫。

translations.literal: The Dzungars attacked the karun outposts at Keshitu, Elunji, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungars struck the karun outposts at Keshitu, Elunji, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 大雄偕總兵樊廷以​​二千人當賊二萬，轉戰七晝夜，拔守卡倫兵以出。

translations.literal: Daxiong together with Regional Commander Fan Ting with two thousand men held off twenty thousand rebels, fought for seven days and nights, and rescued the soldiers defending the karun.
translations.idiomatic: With Regional Commander Fan Ting, Daxiong held twenty thousand rebels at bay with two thousand men, fought seven days and nights, and extricated the garrison of the karun.

sentences.zh: 與總兵張元佐等師會，力戰殺賊。

translations.literal: He joined forces with Regional Commander Zhang Yuanzuo and others, fought fiercely, and killed rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Regional Commander Zhang Yuanzuo and others, fought hard, and killed many rebels.

sentences.zh: 賜拜他喇布勒哈番世職，賚白金五千。

translations.literal: He was granted the hereditary rank of Baitalabulehafan and given five thousand taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the hereditary rank of Baitalabulehafan and rewarded with five thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 尋授直隸山永協副將。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed brigade deputy commander of Shanyong in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made brigade deputy commander of Shanyong in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 命署湖北彝陵鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was ordered to serve as acting regional commander of Yiling in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve as acting regional commander of Yiling in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 上言：「彝陵距省千餘裡，兵餉歲以四季支給，請改夏秋、冬春二次匯支。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial: "Yiling is more than a thousand li from the provincial capital; troops' pay is currently disbursed in four seasonal allotments — I request it be changed to two consolidated payments in summer-autumn and winter-spring."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Yiling lies more than a thousand li from the provincial capital, and troop pay is issued in four seasonal installments; I ask that it be paid instead in two lump sums, in summer-autumn and winter-spring."

sentences.zh: 」下督撫議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was referred to the governor-general and governor for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the proposal to the governor-general and governor for review and implementation.

sentences.zh: 尋調署山西大同鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to serve as acting regional commander of Datong in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to acting regional commander of Datong in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 與前任總兵李如栢互劾，均奪職。

translations.literal: He and the former regional commander Li Rubo impeached each other, and both were dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He and the former regional commander Li Rubo impeached each other, and both were stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，以副將發湖廣，尋授衡州協副將。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was dispatched to Huguang as a brigade deputy and soon appointed brigade deputy commander of Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 (1736) he was posted to Huguang as a brigade deputy and soon made brigade deputy commander of Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 城綏苗、瑤為亂，大雄駐長安堡，焚賊寨，戮其渠，餘相率就撫。

translations.literal: The Miao and Yao of Chengsui rebelled; Daxiong stationed at Chang'an Fort, burned rebel stockades, killed their leaders, and the rest successively submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the Miao and Yao of Chengsui rose, Daxiong encamped at Chang'an Fort, burned rebel stockades, killed their chiefs, and the remainder came in one after another.

sentences.zh: 擢鎮筸鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander of Zhengan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander of Zhengan.

sentences.zh: 總督孫嘉淦劾大雄貪縱，奪職。

translations.literal: Governor-General Sun Jiagan impeached Daxiong for greed and indulgence, and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Sun Jiagan impeached him for greed and lax discipline, and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 湖南巡撫蔣溥言讞無貪縱跡，引見，复授雲南昭通鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Hunan Governor Jiang Pu said the verdict found no evidence of greed or indulgence; Daxiong was granted an audience and again appointed regional commander of Zhaotong in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan Governor Jiang Pu reported that the case showed no proof of greed or indulgence; Daxiong was summoned to audience and restored as regional commander of Zhaotong in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 敘剿苗功，加都督僉事銜。

translations.literal: For his merit in suppressing the Miao, he was given the additional title of Assistant Commissioner-in-chief of the Chief Commandant's Office.
translations.idiomatic: For his service against the Miao he was given the additional rank of Assistant Commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十三年，從征金川，至卡撒，統雲南、貴州諸軍進攻色底、光多諸寨。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he joined the Jinchuan campaign, reached Kasai, and commanded the armies of Yunnan and Guizhou in attacking the stockades at Sedi, Guangduo, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirteen he joined the Jinchuan campaign, reached Kasai, and took command of the Yunnan and Guizhou forces against Sedi, Guangduo, and neighboring stockades.

sentences.zh: 引兵出昔嶺中峰之西，與署總兵哈攀龍、任舉師會，克大小碉十、石城一，墮碉百三十。

translations.literal: He led troops out to the west of the central peak of Xiling, joined forces with Acting Regional Commander Ha Panlong and Ren Ju, captured ten blockhouses large and small and one stone fortress, and destroyed one hundred thirty blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops west of Xiling's central peak, united with Acting Regional Commander Ha Panlong and Ren Ju, took ten blockhouses large and small plus one stone fortress, and demolished one hundred thirty blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 同攻克昔嶺溝底石城水卡。

translations.literal: Together they captured the stone fortress and water palisade at the bottom of Xiling Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: Together they captured the stone fortress and water palisade at the foot of Xiling Ravine.

sentences.zh: 經略大學士傅恆奏大雄歷經戰陣，令總理營壘，措置妥協，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary and Commissioner-General Fu Heng memorialized that Daxiong had passed through many battles, ordered him to take charge of encampments and fortifications, his arrangements were thoroughly satisfactory, and he was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary and commissioner-general Fu Heng reported that Daxiong, a veteran of many battles, had been put in charge of camps and fortifications with thoroughly sound results, and he was awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 金川頭人莎羅奔等乞降，師還。

translations.literal: The Jinchuan chieftains Suoluoben and others sued for surrender, and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jinchuan chieftains Suoluoben and others sued for surrender, the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 授雲南提督，加左都督銜。

translations.literal: He was appointed provincial military commander of Yunnan and given the additional rank of Left Chief Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed provincial commander of Yunnan with the additional rank of Left Chief Commandant.

sentences.zh: 入覲，官其子繼鈞藍翎侍衛，命送大雄上官。

translations.literal: Called to court for an audience, his son Jijun was given office as an imperial guardsman with the blue arrow feather, and ordered to escort Daxiong to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to court, he had his son Jijun appointed an imperial guardsman with the blue arrow feather and ordered to escort Daxiong to his new command.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「西藏喀拉烏蘇諸地與準噶爾連界，盜竊紛擾，是其故習。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Places such as Kalawusu in Tibet border on Dzungar territory; theft and raids are constantly troubling — this is their old habit.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "In places such as Kalawusu on Tibet's frontier, which adjoin Dzungar lands, brigandage and raids are chronic — an old pattern there."

sentences.zh: 今藏北鄙即我邊地，防邊自可弭盜。

translations.literal: Now Tibet's northern frontier is our borderland; guarding the frontier can naturally suppress brigandage.
translations.idiomatic: "Tibet's northern marches are now our border; solid frontier defense will itself check the robbers."

sentences.zh: 請駐藏大臣仍設重兵，循大道置台站，以資防守。

translations.literal: I request that the resident commissioner in Tibet continue to maintain strong forces and establish relay stations along the main road to support defense."
translations.idiomatic: "I ask that the resident commissioner in Tibet keep substantial troops in place and set relay stations along the main road for defense."

sentences.zh: 」上嘉其留心。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his attentiveness.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his careful attention to the matter.

sentences.zh: 繼鈞至常德迎家，中途假回民金，大雄以聞。

translations.literal: Jijun reached Changde to meet the family; on the way he borrowed money from the people; Daxiong reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Jijun went to Changde to fetch the family; en route he borrowed money from the local people, and Daxiong reported it.

sentences.zh: 上以大雄知事不可揜乃始奏劾，左授哈密總兵。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Daxiong had known of the matter but only reported and impeached when it could no longer be concealed, demoted him to regional commander of Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Because Daxiong had known of the affair yet reported and impeached only when it could no longer be hidden, the emperor demoted him to regional commander of Hami.

sentences.zh: 命署安西提督，赴巴里坤驗馬駝，疏報四千餘。

translations.literal: He was ordered to serve as acting provincial military commander of Anxi, proceed to Barkol to inspect horses and camels, and memorialized reporting more than four thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve as acting provincial commander of Anxi, inspect horses and camels at Barkol, and reported more than four thousand on hand.

sentences.zh: 會總督方觀承核參將鍾世傑等至巴里坤領馬千九百餘，途中馬多死，論罪。

translations.literal: When Governor-General Fang Guancheng verified that Regimental Colonel Zhong Shijie and others had reached Barkol to receive more than nineteen hundred horses, many horses died en route, and they were punished.
translations.idiomatic: When Governor-General Fang Guancheng verified that Regimental Colonel Zhong Shijie and others had drawn more than nineteen hundred horses at Barkol, with many dying on the road, they were punished.

sentences.zh: 上以大雄疏不實，下部議；

translations.literal: The emperor, because Daxiong's memorial was inaccurate, referred the matter to the ministry for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Finding Daxiong's report inaccurate, the emperor referred the case to the ministry for adjudication.

sentences.zh: 總督黃廷桂复劾大雄，命奪官，逮京師治罪。

translations.literal: Governor-General Huang Tinggui again impeached Daxiong; he was ordered stripped of office, arrested, and brought to the capital for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Huang Tinggui impeached him again; he was stripped of rank, arrested, and sent to the capital for trial.

sentences.zh: 二十一年四月，行至西安，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-first year, while traveling, he reached Xi'an and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year twenty-one, while being conveyed to the capital, he reached Xi'an and died.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，上以綠營世職不得世襲罔替，下兵部察諸將有功者，俟襲次畢，賜恩騎尉世襲罔替，大雄與焉。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, because Green Standard Army hereditary offices could not pass down in perpetuity, the emperor ordered the Board of War to examine meritorious generals and, when the line of succession was exhausted, grant the hereditary rank of Enriched Cavalry Captain with perpetual succession; Daxiong was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-two, because Green Standard hereditary offices could not pass in perpetuity, the emperor ordered the Board of War to review meritorious officers and, once a line of succession ended, grant the rank of Enriched Cavalry Captain in perpetual inheritance; Daxiong was included.

sentences.zh: 馬良柱，甘肅張掖人，其先本回部。

translations.literal: Ma Liangzhu was a native of Zhangye in Gansu; his ancestors were originally from the Hui communities.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Liangzhu was from Zhangye in Gansu; his family traced its descent to the Hui communities.

sentences.zh: 康熙季年，從軍徵吐魯蕃；

translations.literal: In the final years of Kangxi he joined the army and campaigned against Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi's last years he took the field against Turfan.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，將軍阿爾邦檄赴插漢麥里幹討賊：皆有功。

translations.literal: In the early Yongzheng period, General A'erbang dispatched him to Chahan Mailigen to suppress rebels: in both he had merit.
translations.idiomatic: In early Yongzheng, General A'erbang sent him to Chahan Mailigen to suppress rebels; in both campaigns he distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 復從安西鎮總兵孫繼宗攻羅卜藏丹津，降台吉三十三。

translations.literal: Again he followed Regional Commander Sun Jizong of Anxi in attacking Lobzang Danjin and received the surrender of thirty-three taiji.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Anxi Regional Commander Sun Jizong against Lobzang Danjin and received the submission of thirty-three taiji.

sentences.zh: 戰於哈馬兒打布罕噶斯，擒其渠，授藍翎侍衛，賜白金百，遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Fighting at Hami'erdabuhangasi, he captured their leader, was appointed an imperial guardsman with the blue arrow feather, given a hundred taels of white silver, and transferred to third-class imperial guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: At Hami'erdabuhangasi he captured the rebel chief, was made an imperial guardsman with the blue arrow feather, given a hundred taels of silver, and promoted to third-class imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 外授四川提標游擊，賜貂皮、數珠。

translations.literal: Posted outside the capital as battalion colonel of the Sichuan provincial command, he was granted sable fur and prayer beads.
translations.idiomatic: Posted as battalion colonel of the Sichuan provincial command, he was granted sable fur and prayer beads.

sentences.zh: 命將兵屯西藏。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead troops to garrison Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to lead troops in garrison duty in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 旋以兵擾民，左降，聽四川巡撫、提督調遣。

translations.literal: Soon, because his troops disturbed the populace, he was demoted, and placed under the dispatch of the Sichuan governor and provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, after his men harassed the people, he was demoted and placed under the orders of the Sichuan governor and provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 八年，瞻對土司為亂，提督黃廷桂檄良柱討之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Zhandui native official rebelled; Provincial Commander Huang Tinggui dispatched Liangzhu to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In year eight, when the Zhandui native ruler rebelled, Provincial Commander Huang Tinggui sent Liangzhu to put him down.

sentences.zh: 賊堅守石碉，督兵仰攻，槍殪所乘馬，易馬進，再殪，乃步行督戰。

translations.literal: The rebels held firm in stone blockhouses; he directed troops in an uphill assault; a musket killed the horse he was riding; he changed horses and advanced; it was killed again, and then he walked on foot to direct the battle.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held stone blockhouses; he led an uphill assault, had his mount shot from under him, remounted, lost a second horse, and then walked on foot to direct the fight.

sentences.zh: 碉上投石如雨，傷面，搏賊益奮，火其碉，並焚擦馬、擦牙諸寨，殲賊無算。

translations.literal: Stones rained from the blockhouses; he was wounded in the face; fighting the rebels with even greater vigor, he burned their blockhouses and also burned the stockades at Cama, Caya, and elsewhere, destroying countless rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Stones poured from the blockhouses and wounded his face, but he fought all the harder, burned the forts, and torched the stockades at Cama, Caya, and elsewhere, killing rebels beyond count.

sentences.zh: 側冷邦諸頭人皆降。

translations.literal: The chieftains of Celengbang and elsewhere all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftains of Celengbang and neighboring districts all submitted.

sentences.zh: 复授松潘鎮左營游擊。

translations.literal: He was again appointed battalion colonel of the left camp of Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as battalion colonel of Songpan's left camp.

sentences.zh: 三遷夔州協副將。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became brigade deputy commander of Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became brigade deputy commander of Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年，師复徵瞻對，破直達、鬆多諸寨，奪碉七十餘。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Qianlong the army again campaigned against Zhandui, broke the stockades at Zhida and Songduo and elsewhere, and seized more than seventy blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 10 (1745) the army marched again on Zhandui, broke the stockades at Zhida, Songduo, and elsewhere, and took more than seventy blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 進攻下密左山梁，獲頭人噶籠丹坪。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack the left ridge of Xiami, he captured the chieftain Galong Danping.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on the left ridge of Xiami, he captured the chieftain Galong Danping.

sentences.zh: 再進克下密等百餘寨，獲頭人塔巴四交。

translations.literal: Pressing forward he captured more than a hundred stockades including Xiami and captured the chieftain Taba Sijiao.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing further he took more than a hundred stockades including Xiami and captured the chieftain Taba Sijiao.

sentences.zh: 渡丫魯河，遂破瞻對，焚其寨。

translations.literal: Crossing the Yalu River, he then broke Zhandui and burned its stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Yalu River, he broke Zhandui and burned its stockades.

sentences.zh: 其渠姜錯太死於火。

translations.literal: Its leader Jiang Cuotai died in the flames.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief Jiang Cuotai perished in the fire.

sentences.zh: 十二年，大金川酋莎羅奔攻革布什咱土司，並掠明正土司所屬魯密、章谷諸地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suoluoben attacked the native official of Gebushenzha and also raided Lumi, Zhanggu, and other territories belonging to the Mingzheng native official.
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve the Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suoluoben attacked the Gebushenzha native ruler and raided Lumi, Zhanggu, and other districts under the Mingzheng native official.

sentences.zh: 巡撫紀山移良柱威茂協副將，督兵防禦。

translations.literal: Governor Jishan transferred Liangzhu to brigade deputy commander of Weimao and directed troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Jishan moved Liangzhu to brigade deputy commander of Weimao and put him in charge of the defensive forces.

sentences.zh: 莎羅奔糾小金川土司澤旺侵沃日各寨，都司馬光祖赴援，賊大至，光祖困於熱籠。

translations.literal: Suoluoben rallied Lesser Jinchuan native official Zewang to invade the stockades of Wori; Battalion Commander Ma Guangzu went to their aid; the rebels came in force and Guangzu was trapped at Relong.
translations.idiomatic: Suoluoben joined Lesser Jinchuan's Zewang in an invasion of Wori's stockades; Battalion Commander Ma Guangzu went to relieve them, but the rebels came in strength and trapped Guangzu at Relong.

sentences.zh: 良柱率輕騎馳救，敗賊巴納山，進克石卡二百二十三。

translations.literal: Liangzhu led a light cavalry force in a rapid rescue, defeated the rebels at Bana Mountain, and advanced to capture two hundred twenty-three stone palisades.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu galloped to the rescue with a light cavalry detachment, routed the rebels at Bana Mountain, and pushed on to take two hundred twenty-three stone palisades.

sentences.zh: 光祖等出應，賊潰，圍解。

translations.literal: Guangzu and others came out to meet them; the rebels were routed and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzu and the others sallied forth; the rebels broke and the siege was raised.

sentences.zh: 澤旺降，並還所侵沃日三寨。

translations.literal: Zewang surrendered and also returned the three stockades of Wori he had seized.
translations.idiomatic: Zewang submitted and restored the three Wori stockades he had taken.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其奮勇，遷重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: An edict praised his valor and promoted him to regional commander of Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised his daring and promoted him to regional commander of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 再進复孫克宗官寨，攻江卡，戰屢勝，克大小碉寨百餘，降二十餘寨。

translations.literal: Advancing again he recovered the stockade of Sunkezong, attacked Jiangka, won repeated battles, captured more than a hundred blockhouses and stockades large and small, and received the surrender of more than twenty stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on he retook Sunkezong stockade, attacked Jiangka, won battle after battle, took more than a hundred forts and stockades, and received the submission of more than twenty stockades.

sentences.zh: 進克丹噶山，分兵焚撒籠等七寨，噶固等寨先後降。

translations.literal: Advancing he captured Danga Mountain, detached troops to burn seven stockades including Salong, and stockades including Gagu surrendered one after another.
translations.idiomatic: He took Danga Mountain, sent detachments to burn seven stockades including Salong, and Gagu and other stockades submitted in turn.

sentences.zh: 賊守石達大碉，良柱冒雨進，數十戰，賊乘夜來撲營，設伏，殲焉。

translations.literal: The rebels held the great blockhouse at Shida; Liangzhu advanced in the rain through dozens of battles; the rebels came by night to storm the camp; he set an ambush and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held the great blockhouse at Shida; Liangzhu pushed forward through the rain in dozens of fights; when the rebels raided the camp by night he ambushed and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 馬邦頭人思錯已降，總兵許應虎馭之不以道，复叛，圍應虎於的交，良柱馳救。

translations.literal: The Mabang chieftain Sicuo had already surrendered; Regional Commander Xu Yinghu drove him harshly and he rebelled again, surrounding Yinghu at Dijiao; Liangzhu galloped to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Mabang chieftain Sicuo had submitted, but Regional Commander Xu Yinghu mistreated him until he rebelled again and besieged Yinghu at Dijiao; Liangzhu rode to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 賊退入戎布寨，攻之未下。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew into Rongbu stockade; the attack did not succeed at once.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back into Rongbu stockade, which did not fall immediately.

sentences.zh: 旋复犯馬邦，副將張興被圍。

translations.literal: Soon they again raided Mabang, and Brigade Deputy Zhang Xing was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: They soon struck Mabang again and surrounded Brigade Deputy Zhang Xing.

sentences.zh: 良柱請移戎布師赴援，總督張廣泗不許，興陷於賊。

translations.literal: Liangzhu requested that the troops at Rongbu be moved to the rescue; Governor Zhang Guangsi would not permit it, and Xing fell into the rebels' hands.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu asked to shift the Rongbu column to the rescue; Governor Zhang Guangsi refused, and Xing was lost to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 侵噶固，守兵叛附賊，奪卡倫七。

translations.literal: They invaded Gagu; the garrison rebelled and joined the rebels, seizing seven karun outposts.
translations.idiomatic: They invaded Gagu; the garrison mutinied to the rebels' side and seized seven karun outposts.

sentences.zh: 廣泗令良柱往攻，力戰，賊未卻。

translations.literal: Guangsi ordered Liangzhu to go attack; after fierce fighting the rebels were not driven off.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsi ordered Liangzhu to attack; despite hard fighting the rebels held their ground.

sentences.zh: 值大雪二十餘日，糧匱，煮鎧弩以食。

translations.literal: Heavy snow lasted more than twenty days; grain ran short, and they boiled armor and crossbows to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Snow fell for more than twenty days; supplies ran out and they boiled armor and crossbow parts for food.

sentences.zh: 力不支，廣泗檄退師。

translations.literal: Unable to hold out, Guangsi by dispatch ordered the army to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: When they could no longer hold, Guangsi ordered a withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 倉卒移營，砲械為賊得。

translations.literal: In the hasty move of camp, cannon and weapons were taken by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the hurried evacuation the rebels captured their cannon and arms.

sentences.zh: 廣泗劾之，命逮詣京師，良柱陳糧絕狀，上特原之。

translations.literal: Guangsi impeached him and ordered him arrested and brought to the capital; Liangzhu explained the state of exhausted supplies, and the emperor specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsi impeached him and ordered him brought to the capital in custody; Liangzhu explained that supplies were exhausted, and the emperor specially pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 命在香山教禁軍雲梯，親臨觀之。

translations.literal: He was ordered to teach scaling-ladder tactics to the forbidden troops at Xiangshan, and the emperor personally came to observe.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to instruct the forbidden troops in scaling-ladder tactics at Xiangshan, with the emperor attending in person.

sentences.zh: 良柱起舞鞭，稱旨，賜大緞、荷包。

translations.literal: Liangzhu danced with his whip to please the emperor and was granted fine silk and a purse.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu performed a whip dance to the emperor's pleasure and received fine silk and an imperial purse.

sentences.zh: 命仍赴金川軍，以副將、參將等官酌量委用。

translations.literal: He was ordered to return to the Jinchuan army and to be employed as appropriate among brigade deputies, regimental colonels, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent back to the Jinchuan army to be employed as brigade deputy, regimental colonel, or other rank as fit.

sentences.zh: 尋授泰宁協副將，大學士傅恆視師，檄良柱攻昔嶺，克之。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed brigade deputy commander of Taining; Grand Secretary Fu Heng took command and by dispatch ordered Liangzhu to attack Xiling; he captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made brigade deputy of Taining; when Grand Secretary Fu Heng took the field he ordered Liangzhu against Xiling, and Liangzhu took it.

sentences.zh: 莎羅奔請降，良柱以十餘騎入其營宣諭。

translations.literal: Suoluoben sued for surrender; Liangzhu entered his camp with a little more than ten horsemen to proclaim the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: When Suoluoben sued for surrender, Liangzhu rode into his camp with barely a dozen men to proclaim the imperial will.

sentences.zh: 授建昌鎮總兵，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: He was appointed regional commander of Jianchang and granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed regional commander of Jianchang and awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 母憂去官。

translations.literal: He left office on account of his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 召入京師，仍令教禁軍習雲梯。

translations.literal: He was summoned to the capital and again ordered to teach the forbidden troops scaling-ladder tactics.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to the capital, he was again set to drill the forbidden troops in scaling-ladder tactics.

sentences.zh: 服闋，授松潘鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed regional commander of Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he was appointed regional commander of Songpan.

sentences.zh: 雜穀土司蒼旺為亂，偕提​​督岳鍾琪討平之。

translations.literal: The Zagu native chieftain Cangwang rebelled; together with Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi he suppressed and pacified the disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zagu chieftain Cangwang rebelled, he joined Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi in suppressing the revolt.

sentences.zh: 尋請老，改籍四川華陽。

translations.literal: Soon he requested retirement and had his household register changed to Huayang in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon sought retirement and had his register transferred to Huayang in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十一。

translations.literal: He died at the age of eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 良柱額然，大目虯髯，邊人畏之，號為獅子頭。

translations.literal: Liangzhu had a broad forehead, large eyes, and a curling beard; the frontier people feared him and called him Lion Head.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu had a broad brow, large eyes, and a curling beard; frontier people feared him and called him Lion Head.

sentences.zh: 善戰，臨陣手鐵鞭一，馬上旋轉如飛。

translations.literal: Skilled in battle, in action he carried a single iron whip and on horseback whirled it like flying.
translations.idiomatic: A fierce fighter, he carried one iron whip in battle and on horseback whirled it like a wheel.

sentences.zh: 其攻噶固，廣泗不為策應，餉又不時至，上知廣泗忌其成功，故特輕其罰雲。

translations.literal: In his attack on Gagu, Guangsi gave him no supporting plan and supplies did not arrive on time; the emperor knew Guangsi resented his success, and therefore especially lightened his punishment.
translations.idiomatic: At Gagu, Guangsi gave no supporting plan and pay arrived late; the emperor knew Guangsi resented his success and therefore especially lightened his punishment.

sentences.zh: 子應詔，官直隸河間副將。

translations.literal: His son Yingzhao held office as brigade deputy commander of Hejian in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yingzhao served as brigade deputy commander of Hejian in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 孫瑜，自有傳。

translations.literal: His grandson Yu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Yu has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 本進忠，甘肅西寧人。

translations.literal: Ben Jinzhong was a native of Xining in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ben Jinzhong was from Xining in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 初入伍，冒姓名曰張元吉，尋請復姓名。

translations.literal: When he first enlisted he used the false name Zhang Yuanji and soon requested restoration of his true name.
translations.idiomatic: On enlistment he had used the alias Zhang Yuanji and soon petitioned to restore his true name.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，從揚武將軍張廣泗援吐魯番，屯魯克沁。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period he followed General Zhang Guangsi in relief of Turfan and was stationed at Lukchun.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng he followed General Zhang Guangsi to relieve Turfan and was stationed at Lukchun.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾來侵，邀擊，擒賊七。

translations.literal: When the Dzungars invaded, he intercepted them and captured seven rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When the Dzungars invaded he intercepted them and took seven prisoners.

sentences.zh: 复追敗之哈喇和卓。

translations.literal: Again he pursued and defeated them at Halahezhuo.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued and defeated them again at Halahezhuo.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，檄赴金川，從征囊得山梁。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he was by dispatch ordered to Jinchuan and campaigned at Nangde mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (1748) he was dispatched to Jinchuan and fought at Nangde ridge.

sentences.zh: 攻碉先登，奪矛，中石，傷。

translations.literal: In assaulting a blockhouse he was first to scale the wall, seized a spear, was struck by a stone, and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Storming a blockhouse he was first over the wall, seized a spear, was struck by a stone, and wounded.

sentences.zh: 從攻普沾，擲火彈入碉，焚碉十三，奪木城。

translations.literal: Following the attack on Puzhan, he threw fire bombs into blockhouses, burned thirteen blockhouses, and seized a wooden fort.
translations.idiomatic: At Puzhan he threw fire bombs into the blockhouses, burned thirteen of them, and took a wooden fort.

sentences.zh: 進戰於樂利噶爾堤克，殪賊。

translations.literal: Advancing he fought at Leliga'ertike and killed rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing forward he fought at Leliga'ertike and killed rebels.

sentences.zh: 攻碉，右股中槍，傷。

translations.literal: In attacking a blockhouse he was shot in the right thigh and wounded.
